history.summary: A very large 3,025 sqft 4BR at a headline-low $853 psf — but that PSF is cheap mainly because the unit is oversized and the 99LH is 26 years old (lease ~73 yrs left). Strong 5.35% appreciation and Bukit Gombak MRT 460m are real positives, weighed against lease decay and the quantum/size niche.
history.rating_rationale: The $853 psf looks like a bargain vs the $1,207 median but that gap is an artifact of size (3,025 sqft) and age — this is the classic oversized-unit/low-PSF trap, not genuine value. 99LH from 2000 means ~73 years remaining and accelerating lease decay over a 5–7yr hold, which caps appreciation despite the historical 5.35% CAGR (101 txns, reliable). $2.58M for a 3,025 sqft 4BR is a thin, niche buyer pool (large-family/multigen only) in OCR D23. NS3 Bukit Gombak 460m and the strong record keep it from Avoid.

history.summary: Guilin View (Bukit Batok St 52, D23 OCR, 655 units, CDL/Guilin Park Properties, TOP 2000, 99LH from Apr-1996, ~68.5 yrs left). This high-floor, fully furnished 1,528 sqft 4BR (blk 28) is asking $1.698M / $1,111 psf. That is the market-clearing level, not a bargain. The latest 4BR print was Sep-26: 1,582 sqft on floors 26-30 at $1.70M / $1,074 psf. The latest same-size print was Feb-26: 1,528 sqft on floors 11-15 at $1.78M / $1,165. The ask is ~4-7% under the 24-month same-size median (~$1,185-1,197) and ~4% under the two cheapest live 1,528 asks ($1.77M, unsold since June). The headline -14.8% vs the age-adjusted D23 median is mostly a sub-market level: D23 includes Hillview/Dairy Farm stock that Bukit Batok never trades at. Against true local peers of the same age and lease (4BR-size prints over the last 24 months: Maysprings $1,161, Northvale $1,145, Palm Gardens $1,118, Parc Vista $1,108), this ask is at parity. Fair price, liquid quantum, sound location, but the lease and a softening 4BR tape cap the forward case.
history.rating_rationale: Neutral: a fairly priced unit in a liquid HDB-upgrader market, not a value entry. In its favour: OCR region; NS3 Bukit Gombak MRT ~360 m; an affordable $1.7M 4BR quantum that undercuts new-launch and EC 4BRs nearby by $0.6M+; real-rent carry of ~3.8% gross (~2% net); bed count verified against URA rental bands ('ok'). Against it: (1) the lease is ~68.5 yrs today and ~61-62 at a 2032-33 exit. CPF pro-rating already bites for most buyers and tightens every year, and decay costs roughly 0.7-0.9%/yr against a freehold-equivalent. (2) The 4BR tape is rolling over: 1,528/1,572 sqft prints went from $1,197-1,269 (2024) to $1,165 (Feb-26) and then $1,074 (Sep-26). Seven competing 4BR asks are live, most cut repeatedly since June. (3) The exit record is middling: REALSCORE 3.5, 75% profitable on 638 matched resale pairs, so one resale in four lost money. (4) MMR's 780 rests heavily on age_value (+11.2) and psf_value, both measured against a D23 median inflated by Hillview, so the cheapness signal is overstated (see the D23 bifurcation memory). Against local peers this is parity pricing. Expected unlevered total return of ~5%/yr (~3% price after lease drag + ~2% net carry) is acceptable but not a buy. The 'price drop' badge is a unit-group chain artifact: this is a new listing (4 Oct 2026, a different agent from the $1.96M blk-24 listing it chains from), not a verified cut. Turns into a lean Buy only at roughly $1.60-1.62M (~$1,050 psf, below the Sep-26 print) after a viewing confirms the high floor faces Little Guilin/Bukit Batok Nature Park rather than the HDB blocks.

4BR prints softening: 1,528-1,582 sqft went from $1,197-1,269 psf (2024) to $1,165 (Feb-26) and $1,074 (Sep-26). The ask is at the latest print, not below it
Supply overhang: 7 live 4BR asks in the project, most repeatedly cut since June 2026 ($1.77-2.01M)
Exit record mixed: REALSCORE 3.5, 75% profitable on 638 resale pairs (160 losing resales, avg hold 10.4 yrs)
'Cheap vs district' is mostly the D23 sub-market level: Bukit Batok vs Hillview/Dairy Farm. At parity with same-age local leasehold peers, so MMR age_value/psf_value are overstated
'Price drop' badge is a unit_group chaining artifact (relisted_from a different agent's blk-24 listing that is still live at $1.96M), not a real cut on this unit
26-yr-old estate: dated finishes and rising sinking-fund/maintenance needs. Stack and facing unverified (no profile; PG gives only 'High Floor', blk 28)
catalysts: NS3 Bukit Gombak MRT ~360 m (NSL direct to Jurong East and Orchard)
Affordable 4BR quantum (~$1.7M) for a deep HDB-upgrader pool (57% of buyers are HDB). New launches and ECs in Tengah/Bukit Batok price 4BRs well above this
Real-rent carry: ~$5,350/mo (URA project-bed contracts; realsmart $3.62 psf/mo ~ $5.5k), ~3.8% gross
Green setting by Little Guilin / Bukit Batok Nature Park; high floors can have park or reservoir views
Tengah forest town and the JRL (2027-28) widen the catchment. Narrative only: the future-infra score has no measured forward power

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: URA project-bed rent of $5,350/mo comes from only 4 contracts in 12 months (confidence 0.665). It is corroborated by realsmart's rent of $3.62 psf/mo (~$5.5k for 1,528 sqft) and a $3.1-5.5k quoted range across all sizes. Gross 3.78% / net ~2.0% is credible, OCR-typical carry. It is income, not an appreciation argument (high yield predicts lower forward PSF growth).
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: The trailing 4.41% 5yr CAGR (98 txns) is a 2021-24 bull-market print with ~0 forward power. Resale-to-resale prints in this size band are flat-to-down since late 2024. Forward view: OCR config baseline ~3.7%/yr less ~0.7-0.9%/yr lease drag at 68 to 62 yrs remaining, so ~3%/yr. REALSCORE 3.5 / 75% profitable / 4.0% avg annualized (638 resale pairs) is downside evidence that a quarter of sellers lost money, not a forecast.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No profile. /research-development was not run: the listing exposes only blk 28 + 'High Floor' with no stack number, so a profile join could not pin the unit, and the verdict's drivers (lease, sub-market level, softening tape) don't depend on stack. Before any offer, verify the facing on viewing: Little Guilin / nature-park side vs HDB-facing. The two other blk-28/blk-20 1,528 sqft units asking $1.77M are the direct live comps.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: Agent: OCR forward baseline ~3.7%/yr less ~0.7-0.9%/yr leasehold decay (68.5 to ~62 yrs remaining over the hold). Resale-to-resale 4BR prints in this project have been flat-to-down since late 2024 ($1,197-1,269 to $1,074-1,165 psf)
